summary: Temple of Sethraliss needs extra enemy-forces planning, broad poison and magic answers, crowd control, and role-aware soaking on the Avatar.
actions: Prioritize Poisoned Cheap Shot, Addle Mind, Poison Spit, Essence Disruption, and Flame Shock interrupts; plan poison and magic removals for failed casts and persistent debuffs.
Purge Accumulate Charge and avoid under-counting trash because the dungeon requires substantial additional enemy forces.
Group near Merektha's indicated target so area crowd control can break A Knot of Snakes quickly.
Crowd-control Temple Disruptors while the Eye of Sethraliss is active so the orb can finish and continue following the party.
Assign damage dealers to Corrupted Lifeforce soaks on the Avatar because the effect increases healing done but also increases Physical damage taken.
